question: 'Matters of Discretion' is an autobiography of which former Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Inder Kumar Gujral**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Inder Kumar Gujral **wrote an autobiography titled **Matters of Discretion: An Autobiography.**
 
• It gives an overview of** Gujral's public life** and discusses** his life **beginning with the partition and his move to India.
 
• He was an** Indian diplomat, politician, and freedom activist.**
 
• From** April 1997 until March 1998**, he was **India's 12th prime minister**.
 
• In **1964,** he joined the** Indian National Congress party** and was elected to the **Rajya Sabha.**
